profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, California, traded on public markets under the ticker AAPL. Its most recent annual filing, a 10-K, reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025. The company describes its core AI offering, Apple Intelligence, as "truly helpful AI that's centered around you and your needs," integrated into apps, grounded in personal context, and private at every step.

Apple Intelligence and a next-generation version of Siri are described on the company's site as coming to iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The site characterizes Siri AI as a conversational assistant capable of open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth dialogue, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, on-screen visual queries, and writing assistance including drafting and style-matched feedback. The company notes that Siri AI will launch in beta in English and will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS. Beyond Apple Intelligence, the held facts track two additional AI-oriented products: Final Cut Pro AI, described as a Mac video editing tool with on-device processing optimized for Apple silicon, and iMovie AI, a consumer video editing application with trailer templates and on-device processing.

The held facts show 175 cases of legal exposure recorded under California jurisdiction and no specific litigation records on file. Two MCP servers are registered in connection with Apple: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients.
